title: Agent Readiness Fleet Posture Response
description: The server-computed fleet debt view for a project. Every agent's debt items and verdict are computed here, server-side, from the same evidence the readiness portfolio/detail responses already serve; the frontend only displays. Behaviour-preserving port of TraigentFrontend src/utils/fleetPosture.ts (deriveAgentDebtItems / computeVerdict / wilsonInterval / rankValidateFirst / summarizeFleet). Content-free beyond the debt/verdict vocabulary itself: no free text, no scores framed as certified/verified.

failed_agent_ids.description: Agents whose detail read raised while computing this response. Omitted from `agents` and from `summary`; the frontend shows its partial-failure banner for these. Always present, possibly empty.

Verdict.description: computeVerdict's four-way outcome (fleetPosture.ts). With today's inputs (criticality_used is always 'medium' and scoreClearsThreshold is always null, see the Policy/AgentPostureEntry descriptions) only NOT_YET_SCORED and CANT_TELL are ever observed; STAY and INTERVENE_QUALITY are kept in the vocabulary because the pure function encodes the whole rule and a later owner decision can make them reachable without a contract change.

DebtItem.description: One open debt item. pillar is fixed per id (DEBT_ITEM_DEFINITIONS in fleetPosture.ts): AG-* is always agent; ES-1/ES-2 are always evaluator; ES-3/ES-4/ES-5 are always evaluation_dataset. Display labels stay in the frontend -- this object carries no label.

ValidityLevel.description: Mirrors fleetPosture.ts's ValidityLevel ('V0' | 'V1' | 'V2', VALIDITY_RANK / REQUIRED_VALIDITY_FOR_STAY), which is intentionally wider than the agent-readiness common schema's EvaluationSystemValidity.level (V0 | V1 only -- V2 is a documented future widening there). V2 is unreachable from today's served evaluation_system_validity (its level is never higher than V1), so effective_validity_level and served_validity_level are V0/V1 in every response TraigentBackend can produce today; V2 is kept in this response's vocabulary now because it is already load-bearing for high-criticality Stay (REQUIRED_VALIDITY_FOR_STAY.high = V2) and adding it later would be a breaking widen of a closed enum.

Interval.description: A Wilson score interval (z = policy.interval_z) over accuracy/sample_size, per wilsonInterval in fleetPosture.ts. Not a CLT interval (agent_readiness_target_schema.json AccuracyEvaluation.ci_method) -- this is a hypothesis/estimate band for display, never a measured target evaluation.

Policy.description: The constants actually used to compute this response, so the frontend can render labels without hand-duplicating them. Every member is a fixed constant (fleetPosture.ts AG2_MIN_SAMPLE_SIZE / ES5_SATURATION_CEILING / ES4_STALE_DAYS / AG3_MIN_REPRODUCTIONS / AG3_JOURNEY_PAGE_SIZE / WILSON_Z_95); a value change is an acknowledged contract change, not a silent behaviour change.

PillarReviewStatus.description: The served pillar `status` values from the same detail validity block that produced this agent's debt items and served_validity_level, for the ES-1/ES-3 labels. Both members are null exactly when served_validity_level is null (no served validity block).

AgentPostureEntry.description: One agent's computed debt/verdict row (buildAgentPostureRow). accuracy, sample_size, interval, dataset_ref_id and evaluator_ref_id are all null exactly when verdict is NOT_YET_SCORED (no anchor run) -- the same 'no anchor run' fact drives every one of them in buildAgentPostureRow.

agent_name.description: Required, non-null, same as the readiness common schema's AgentSummary.name and fleetPosture.ts AgentRefs.agentName: string (never optional/nullable).

debt_items.description: Ordered as deriveAgentDebtItems: evaluation-system items (ES-*) always precede agent items (AG-*).

effective_validity_level.description: resolveEffectiveValidity(served_validity_level, validity_decayed) -- the level actually used by computeVerdict for this agent; collapsed to V0 when validity_decayed is true.

served_validity_level.description: The nominal (as-served) evaluation_system_validity.level for this agent's anchor, before decay. Null when no served E3 block exists.

validity_decayed.description: computeValidityDecayed: true when the evaluator reference changed since calibration or the eval set is stale (incl. the 30-day backstop). When true, effective_validity_level is V0 regardless of served_validity_level.

criticality_used.description: The criticality actually used to select the Stay validity bar (REQUIRED_VALIDITY_FOR_STAY). The Backend does not yet read a per-agent declared criticality for this computation and always uses 'medium' (fleetPosture.ts:903, buildAgentPostureRow's criticality default) -- exposed here, rather than hardcoded to 'medium' in this schema, so a later decision to switch to the agent's declared criticality (TraigentBackend#3505) needs no contract change.

accuracy.description: Passed through unclamped, matching the TS (fleetPosture.ts clamps only for display). No upper bound in this schema -- parity over tidiness.

interval.description: Wilson interval over accuracy/sample_size (policy.interval_method/interval_z), null when not computable (no accuracy, or sample_size is null or 0).

reproductions_in_window.description: countReproductionsOnAnchorRefs, scoped to policy.journey_window: successfully-completed runs sharing the anchor's dataset and evaluator refs. Null when the anchor is missing a dataset or evaluator ref -- reproduction cannot be determined at all, distinct from a known zero (fleetPosture.ts countReproductionsOnAnchorRefs). debt_items still carries AG-3 in either case (null and below-threshold both leave AG-3 open).

has_anchor_run.description: True when this agent has a scored anchor run (served, so the frontend stops inferring it from the presence of the AG-1 debt item). False exactly when verdict is NOT_YET_SCORED.

score_credible.description: The old frontend isScoreCredible(servedValidity), computed server-side from the same detail validity block that produced debt_items, so the label and the debt items can never disagree.

allOf.description: pillar_review_status members are null exactly when served_validity_level is null (no served validity block to read a status from).
reproductions_in_window is null exactly when the anchor is missing a dataset or evaluator ref (countReproductionsOnAnchorRefs' own precondition).
interval is non-null only when accuracy is recorded and sample_size is a positive count (wilsonInterval's own preconditions).

FleetSummary.description: summarizeFleet's per-verdict totals over the agents in this response.

ValidateFirstEntry.description: rankValidateFirst's ValidateFirstEntry (fleetPosture.ts:~707), snake_case: kind/refId/affectedAgentIds -> kind/ref_id/affected_agent_ids. Reach-only ranking (unweighted by exposure/criticality); order is by affected_agent_ids length desc, then kind, then ref_id -- not representable in JSON Schema, verified by the contract test instead of this schema.
